title: The Comic turn in the story
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：comic　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the driver wrote of ① a comic turn in the story in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more comic than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the comic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most comic turn in the story anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too comic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the comic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a comic figure in the street, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as comic as the figure in the street they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was comic or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something comic, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite comic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the comic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, in the rain, she wrote of another comic turn in the story in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more comic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most comic figure in the street in the whole station, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the comic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 喜剧（前置定语 a comic turn in the story：1987 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件喜剧的转折）
B. adj. 喜剧／滑稽（比较级 more comic than：文中两处，一处比故事里的转折，一处比预想）
C. adj. 喜剧／滑稽（最高级 the most comic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 喜剧（表语 too comic to do：母亲觉得它太喜剧，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 滑稽（前置定语 a comic figure in the street：叔叔把整件事称作一桩滑稽的人）
F. adj. 滑稽（同级比较 as comic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩街上的滑稽人相比）
G. adj. 滑稽（后置定语 something comic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 滑稽（受程度副词修饰 quite comic：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a comic turn in the story
the most comic turn in the story anybody
a comic figure in the street
The most comic figure in the street in

answers.why: comic 意为“喜剧”，1987 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件喜剧的转折”，此处作前置定语 a comic turn in the story。
comic 意为“喜剧”，此处用比较级 more comic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
comic 意为“喜剧”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最喜剧的一件，故用最高级 the most comic turn in the story。
comic 意为“喜剧”，母亲认为这件东西“太喜剧了，谁也用不上”，too comic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
comic 意为“滑稽”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩滑稽的人”，此处作前置定语 a comic figure in the street。
comic 意为“滑稽”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩街上的滑稽人一样滑稽”，同级比较用 as comic as。
comic 意为“滑稽”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“滑稽的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something comic。
comic 意为“滑稽”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当滑稽”，quite 修饰原级 comic。
comic 意为“滑稽”，1997 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要滑稽”，故用比较级 more comic than。
comic 意为“滑稽”，母亲 1999 年说的是“整个车站里最滑稽的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most comic figure in the street。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件喜剧的转折。（a comic turn in the story）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更喜剧。（more comic than …）
母亲觉得它太喜剧，谁也用不上。（too comic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩滑稽的人。（a comic figure in the street）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩街上的滑稽人一样滑稽。（as comic as …）
到了 1994 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件滑稽的东西。（something comic）
answers: In 1987 the driver wrote of a comic turn in the story in the timetable.
Everybody said it was more comic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too comic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a comic figure in the street.
He said nobody would call it as comic as the figure in the street they had once had.
By 1994 the timetable asked for nothing but something comic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 comic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the driver wrote of a comic turn in the story in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most comic turn in the story in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too comic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a comic figure in the street, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite comic, and everybody laughed.
The comic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
